question: According to the Hindu calendar, Holi is celebrated on __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phalguna Purnima**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Phalguna Purnima** is the full moon day in the month of Phalguna in the Hindu calendar.
 
• Holi, also known as the Festival of Colors, is celebrated on this day.
 
• The festival signifies the victory of go
